channel.description: Latest articles from The Albert Lea Tribune (albertleatribune.com)

item.title: Poll: Trump’s immigration crackdown deeply unpopular in Minnesota
item.description: MINNEAPOLIS — New polling shows Minnesotans and people across the country widely disapprove of President Donald Trump’s immigration crackdown in the state, a shift that’s turned his deportation campaign from a political strength into a potential liability ahead of the midterm elections.

item.title: Minnesota creates fraud ‘fact check’ amid national political scrutiny
item.description: Incendiary claims about fraud in Minnesota are being aired in congressional hearings, influencer videos and by the White House.

item.title: MnDOT expands trip planner with rural transportation focus
item.description: Residents across Greater Minnesota now have more consistent ways to plan for and, in some cases, book and pay for public transit and intercity bus trips, the Minnesota Department of Transportation announced Wednesday.

item.title: Could Snoop Dogg’s recent Vikings performance beat Bad Bunny’s at Super Bowl LX?
item.description: For fans of the Vikings, Snoop Dogg’s lavish Christmas party is unforgettable.

item.title: Border czar says ICE surge in Minnesota will soon end
item.description: White House border czar Tom Homan, who is overseeing Operation Metro Surge in Minnesota, said the immigration enforcement operation will soon wind down.

item.title: Fugitive arrested after fleeing police, running across Fountain Lake
item.description: Albert Lea police arrested an Austin man Thursday morning who was a fugitive from the state after he fled from a vehicle during a traffic stop, ran across Fountain Lake and was apprehended in the area of Raymond Avenue and Albert Lea Street.

item.title: Pauline Perleberg
item.description: Pauline Perleberg, age 69, passed away on Wednesday, February 11, 2026.

item.title: Beverly “Bev” Jane Prantner
item.description: Beverly “Bev” Jane Prantner, age 97, died Saturday, February 7, 2026, at Sacred Heart Care Center in Austin, Minnesota. She was born March 13, 1928, to Raymond and Mildred (Foss) Hartley at Saint Olaf Hospital, Austin, Minnesota.

item.title: After Facebook Marketplace message, Albert Lea immigrant says federal agents appeared at her home
item.description: An Albert Lea woman looking to sell and give away items on Facebook Marketplace ahead of a move to a new house said she set up a time last month for a man interested in picking up a nightstand, only to see a group of federal immigration agents show up instead.

item.title: Mayo in Albert Lea goes under brief lockdown
item.description: Mayo Clinic Health System in Albert Lea went into a brief lockdown Thursday as a precaution, the health system stated.
